samples.summary: New "a merged block may not straddle a freeze boundary" invariant has bypasses outside the diff (`setFreezePane`, freeze adjust on insert/delete, XLSX import), and blocks created that way are now permanently unmovable
samples.evidence: The diff makes freeze-straddling a hard refusal on two paths (`planPasteMerges` → 'merge-paste-frozen', `moveRangeTo` → 'merge-move-frozen'). Out-of-diff writers of the same state are unguarded: `Sheet.setFreezePane` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:514) sets frozenRows/frozenCols with no check against `this.merges`, the freeze auto-adjustment inside the insert/delete path (sheet.ts:1346-1371) grows/shrinks the frozen region while `shiftMergeMap` (sheet.ts:1327) shifts blocks independently, and the importer writes merges directly (packages/sheets/src/import/xlsx-importer.ts:259 → packages/sheets/src/model/workbook/worksheet-structure.ts:343). Consequence of the new guard: a block that reached a straddling position that way can no longer be drag-moved or pasted at all — every attempt is refused with 'merge-move-frozen'/'merge-paste-frozen', so the user cannot even move it out of the boundary. The project's own task note acknowledges the bypass as "not taken" (docs/tasks/active/20260912-sheets-paste-merge-propagation-todo.md:122). Fix belongs either on `setFreezePane` (reject/unmerge straddlers) or by relaxing the new refusal when the block already straddles.

samples.summary: Copy buffer now survives pastes, but no structural edit invalidates or shifts `copyBuffer.sourceRange`/`merges`, so a repeat paste after an insert/delete/undo relocates (and now re-creates merges) from stale coordinates
samples.evidence: `copyBuffer` is only assigned/cleared at sheet.ts:2155, 2176, 2141 and 2286; nothing in the insert/delete path invalidates it. `insertRows`/`removeRows` shift the merge map and selection (`shiftMergeMap`, sheet.ts:1327), row/col reorder shifts it again (`moveMergeMap`, sheet.ts:1516), and `undo`/`redo` reload merges wholesale (sheet.ts:5185-5227) — none touch the buffer. Previously both view paste handlers cleared the buffer right after the first paste (worksheet.ts:4947, spreadsheet.ts:728), bounding the staleness window; with that removed the buffer lives until Escape, so copy → insert a row → Ctrl+V now takes the internal path with a delta computed from the pre-insert `sourceRange`, and the new `planPasteMerges` additionally re-creates merged blocks at anchors derived from that stale delta (sheet.ts:2250-2265). Fix belongs on the new lifetime: invalidate or shift `copyBuffer` in the structural-edit and undo paths.

samples.summary: Dropping the unconditional `clearCopyBuffer()` leaves a pending cut armed and its marching ants drawn after an intervening external paste
samples.evidence: With the clear removed at packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:4947 and packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:728, `paste` only drops the buffer when the clipboard text matches (sheet.ts:2286). After Ctrl+X then an external copy/paste (non-matching text), `isCutMode()` stays true and `getCopyRange()` still returns the source, which the overlay keeps rendering as cut marching ants (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5600-5601, packages/sheets/src/view/overlay.ts:783). If the original clipboard content is later restored, the stale cut still deletes the source region. Only the Escape handler (worksheet.ts:5114-5121) clears it now.

verdict.reason: All structural claims verify. `Sheet.setFreezePane` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:514-518) sets frozenRows/frozenCols with no check against `this.merges`, and it is reachable from the UI without any merge guard via the freeze-handle drag (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:2970-2977) and double-click (view/worksheet.ts:1381-1394) through `Worksheet.setFreezePane` (view/worksheet.ts:467-474). The insert/delete freeze adjust (sheet.ts:1345-1371) moves the frozen boundary while merges are shifted independently at sheet.ts:1327. The XLSX importer writes merges directly with no freeze validation (packages/sheets/src/import/xlsx-importer.ts:258-262). Meanwhile the new refusals do exist and enforce the invariant only on the paste/move paths (sheet.ts:2429-2433, sheet.ts:2685-2695, via crossesFreezePane at sheet.ts:2500-2509), matching canMergeSelection at sheet.ts:4678. So the 'no merge straddles a freeze boundary' invariant that these guards and the renderer rely on can be violated through unguarded writers outside the diff — in-lane as a guard bypass / violated invariant, impact major. One supporting claim is overstated: because moveRangeTo tests the translated destination range (sheet.ts:2686-2691), a straddling block CAN still be dragged fully clear of the boundary; only moves that keep it straddling are refused. That inaccuracy does not refute the core finding, and no named refutation ground (not-present / already-guarded / out-of-scope) applies.

finding.summary: Copy buffer now survives pastes, but no structural edit invalidates or shifts `copyBuffer.sourceRange`/`merges`, so a repeat paste after an insert/delete/undo relocates (and now re-creates merges) from stale coordinates
finding.evidence: `copyBuffer` is only assigned/cleared at sheet.ts:2155, 2176, 2141 and 2286; nothing in the insert/delete path invalidates it. `insertRows`/`removeRows` shift the merge map and selection (`shiftMergeMap`, sheet.ts:1327), row/col reorder shifts it again (`moveMergeMap`, sheet.ts:1516), and `undo`/`redo` reload merges wholesale (sheet.ts:5185-5227) — none touch the buffer. Previously both view paste handlers cleared the buffer right after the first paste (worksheet.ts:4947, spreadsheet.ts:728), bounding the staleness window; with that removed the buffer lives until Escape, so copy → insert a row → Ctrl+V now takes the internal path with a delta computed from the pre-insert `sourceRange`, and the new `planPasteMerges` additionally re-creates merged blocks at anchors derived from that stale delta (sheet.ts:2250-2265). verdict.reason: The code is present exactly as described. `copyBuffer` (sheet.ts:380-387) is assigned only in copy/cut (sheet.ts:2155, 2176) and cleared only via `clearCopyBuffer()` (sheet.ts:2141) and the consumed-cut path (sheet.ts:2286). The sole product caller of `clearCopyBuffer()` is the Escape handler (view/worksheet.ts:5118); the paste handler deliberately no longer clears it (view/worksheet.ts:4941-4947), so the buffer's lifetime is now unbounded. Meanwhile every structural-edit path shifts its other cached coordinate state but never the buffer: insert/delete shifts rangeStyles, conditional formats, validations, merges (`shiftMergeMap`, sheet.ts:1327), filter/hidden state and selection anchors (sheet.ts:1309-1334); row/col move shifts merges again (`moveMergeMap`, sheet.ts:1516); undo/redo reload dimensions/styles/merges wholesale (sheet.ts:5185-5211, 5217-5239). None invalidate or shift `copyBuffer`. The staleness reaches live-coordinate consumers: the cut path deletes cells and subtracts styles over the recorded `cutSourceRange` against the live store (sheet.ts:2311, 2356-2366) — and a refused paste now returns with the buffer still armed (sheet.ts:2270-2273), so a structural edit can intervene before the retry, deleting unrelated cells; `getCopyRange()` (sheet.ts:2126) also drives the marching-ants overlay at view/worksheet.ts:5600, which will paint pre-edit coordinates. This is squarely in the blast-radius lane: a lifetime/invariant change to an exported behaviour whose other consumers (structural edits, undo/redo, cut source clearing, overlay) were not updated, with data-affecting impact at those sites. I weighed a counterexample refutation — the snapshot grid/merges and `sourceRange` are internally consistent, so a pure copy-paste still reproduces the copied layout correctly at the destination — but that argument does not cover the live-coordinate consumers above, so it is not sufficient to drop the finding.

finding.summary: Row/column reorder (`moveCells`) relocates merged blocks with no freeze-straddle check, bypassing the invariant this PR newly enforces in `planPasteMerges` and `moveRangeTo`
finding.evidence: `moveCells` at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1465 validates only `isMergeSplitByMove` (line 1478-1483) and then translates every block wholesale via `this.merges = moveMergeMap(...)` (line 1516) — no `crossesFreezePane` call. With `frozenRows = 2` and a block at rows 5-6, dragging those rows to index 2 lands the block on rows 2-3, exactly the state the new `merge-paste-frozen` / `merge-move-frozen` refusals (sheet.ts:2430, 2685) declare undrawable because the renderer paints the frozen pane and the body from one block. Same shape for `shiftMergeMap` on insert/delete at sheet.ts:1327, though the freeze-count adjustment at 1347-1371 mitigates most of those cases. The fix belongs on `moveCells`, not on the new paste code.

verdict.reason: Verified in the repo. `moveCells` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1465) only rejects moves that split a merge via `isMergeSplitByMove` (lines 1478-1483) and then relocates every block wholesale with `this.merges = moveMergeMap(...)` (line 1516); there is no `crossesFreezePane` call and no freeze-count adjustment anywhere in that method (the only freeze adjustment lives in the insert/delete path at lines 1346-1368). Meanwhile the new invariant is enforced for paste (`merge-paste-frozen`, sheet.ts:2429-2433) and for drag-move of a range (`merge-move-frozen`, sheet.ts:2687-2693), with the helper at sheet.ts:2500-2510 defining the straddle test. `moveCells` is publicly reachable via `moveRows`/`moveColumns` (sheet.ts:1279-1288) which are invoked directly from the header drag-reorder UI at packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:4656-4659 with no freeze guard in the caller (onComplete only rejects no-op drops, lines 4648-4654). So with frozenRows=2 and a block at rows 5-6, dragging those rows to index 2 produces exactly the straddling state the new refusals declare undrawable — a reachable bypass of the newly enforced invariant in a code path the diff does not show. That is squarely the blast-radius lane ("a new guard with a way around it"), and the impact (corrupt render state / invariant violation the renderer assumes) grades major.

finding.summary: Both view paste paths stopped clearing the copy buffer, so `copyBuffer` now lives indefinitely — but no structural edit invalidates or shifts it, so a later paste relocates from a stale source range and stale merge snapshot
finding.evidence: `copyBuffer = undefined` now only happens in `clearCopyBuffer` (sheet.ts:2141, reached solely from the Escape keybinding at packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5118) and on a consumed cut (sheet.ts:2286). Nothing in `insertRows`/`deleteRows` (`shiftMergeMap`, sheet.ts:1327) or `moveCells` (sheet.ts:1516) shifts or drops `copyBuffer.sourceRange` / `copyBuffer.merges`. After copy → insert rows → Ctrl+V (clipboard text unchanged), `paste` still takes the internal branch and computes `deltaRow/deltaCol` (sheet.ts:2250) and `planPasteMerges`' destination range from a source range that no longer describes the data, mis-relocating formulas and applying a stale merge layout. The marching-ants overlay at packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5600 renders the same stale `getCopyRange()` indefinitely. Previously the view cleared the buffer right after each paste, which bounded this window to a single paste.

verdict.reason: Every claimed location verified. `copyBuffer` (sheet.ts:380-387) is only cleared by `clearCopyBuffer()` (sheet.ts:2140-2142), whose sole production caller is the Escape keybinding (view/worksheet.ts:5117-5119), and by the consumed-cut branch (sheet.ts:2286). Both view paste paths deliberately no longer clear it (view/worksheet.ts:4941-4947, view/spreadsheet.ts:724-728), so a non-cut buffer lives indefinitely. `shiftCells` (sheet.ts:1293-1334) shifts every other positional structure on row/column insert/delete — rangeStyles (1309), conditionalFormats (1315), dataValidations (1321), merges via shiftMergeMap (1327), filter/hidden state, anchors (1334) — but never touches `copyBuffer`; the row/column move paths (1280, 1287) likewise do not. That structural edit is reachable with a live buffer via view/spreadsheet.ts:778-793. A later paste still enters the internal branch on text equality alone (sheet.ts:2243) and derives deltaRow/deltaCol (sheet.ts:2250-2251) plus the planPasteMerges destination (sheet.ts:2258-2265) from the stale sourceRange, mis-relocating formulas/styles and applying a stale merge layout; the marching-ants overlay renders the same stale range (view/worksheet.ts:5600-5601). No guard revalidates the buffer against current geometry, so nothing makes this unreachable. This is an invariant other code (shiftCells) relies on being maintained, violated at the sites that read it — in lane and major.
